# WAS_TransformData { #wass2s.WAS_TransformData }

```python
WAS_TransformData(data, distribution_map=None, n_clusters=1000)
```

Optimized class for geospatial Time-Series analysis: 
Skewness detection, Transformation, and Distribution Fitting.

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [apply_transformation](#wass2s.WAS_TransformData.apply_transformation) | Apply transformations using vectorized ufuncs for speed. |
| [detect_skewness](#wass2s.WAS_TransformData.detect_skewness) | Compute and classify skewness for each grid cell. |
| [fit_best_distribution](#wass2s.WAS_TransformData.fit_best_distribution) | Fit best distributions using either clustering or per-grid methods. |
| [handle_skewness](#wass2s.WAS_TransformData.handle_skewness) | Recommend transformations based on skewness. |
| [inverse_transform](#wass2s.WAS_TransformData.inverse_transform) | Reverse transformations to recover original scale. |

### apply_transformation { #wass2s.WAS_TransformData.apply_transformation }

```python
WAS_TransformData.apply_transformation(method=None)
```

Apply transformations using vectorized ufuncs for speed.
Stores parameters (lambdas) in self.transform_params.

### detect_skewness { #wass2s.WAS_TransformData.detect_skewness }

```python
WAS_TransformData.detect_skewness()
```

Compute and classify skewness for each grid cell.

### fit_best_distribution { #wass2s.WAS_TransformData.fit_best_distribution }

```python
WAS_TransformData.fit_best_distribution(use_transformed=False, mode='cluster')
```

Fit best distributions using either clustering or per-grid methods.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type            | Description   | Default     |
|--------|-----------------|---------------|-------------|
| mode   | (cluster, grid) |               | `'cluster'` |

### handle_skewness { #wass2s.WAS_TransformData.handle_skewness }

```python
WAS_TransformData.handle_skewness()
```

Recommend transformations based on skewness.

### inverse_transform { #wass2s.WAS_TransformData.inverse_transform }

```python
WAS_TransformData.inverse_transform(data=None)
```

Reverse transformations to recover original scale.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type             | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | Default   |
|--------|------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| data   | xarray.DataArray | If provided (e.g., model predictions), this data will be inverted  using the parameters learned during the `apply_transformation` step. If None, the internal `self.transformed_data` is inverted.  IMPORTANT: `data` must have the same Y and X coordinates/dimensions  as the original data so the correct lambda matches the correct pixel. | `None`    |
